governance: Reviewer aid only. Each link names an exact record ID in an existing repository artifact (P36 registry, P35.5 draft catalog, Bone handbook v7, Nikolas source intakes and the P38-P43 reconciliation worksheets) so the reviewer can inspect it. A link is never a mapping, alias, unit equivalence or approval; no link is inferred by fuzzy matching at runtime.
